name: ETH Zurich
description: ETH (the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology) Zurich is Switzerland's federal institute of technology in Zurich, founded in 1855. It focuses on science, engineering, mathematics and architecture.
whyIncluded: ETH (the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology) runs the Singapore-ETH Centre, its only research centre outside Switzerland, set up in 2010 with Singapore's National Research Foundation at the CREATE (the Campus for Research Excellence and Technological Enterprise); it offers English-taught master's programmes, and Switzerland is among the ten destinations with the most Singaporean students abroad (about 280 in the UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS; UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) data for 2022-24).

livingCosts.notes: ETH Financial Aid Office 'Study and Living Costs, international students (approximate)' PDF, annual figures / 12: rent (room incl. heating, canton of Zurich average 2024) CHF 11,300; meals incl. refectory CHF 7,200; public transport (Zurich city, age 25 or under) CHF 586; personal = individual expenses CHF 1,680 + study material CHF 1,000. Excludes health insurance (CHF 1,320), excursions (CHF 500), tuition and semester fees. ETH's own total incl. insurance is CHF 22,100 a year.

programmes.name: BSc Mechanical Engineering
programmes.notes: Fee group 2 (students who move to Switzerland to study): threefold tuition CHF 2,190 per semester x 2, in force since autumn 2025 and indexed to the CPI every four years (first in 2029). Compulsory semester fees ASVZ sports 35 + scholarship fund 7 + VSETH 32 = CHF 74 x 2. One-off application fee CHF 150 for a non-Swiss matriculation certificate. Exam fees included. 3-year (180 ECTS) bachelor's taught in German.

programmes.name: BSc Human Medicine
programmes.notes: Fee group 2 (students who move to Switzerland to study): threefold tuition CHF 2,190 per semester x 2, in force since autumn 2025 and indexed to the CPI every four years (first in 2029). Compulsory semester fees ASVZ sports 35 + scholarship fund 7 + VSETH 32 = CHF 74 x 2. One-off application fee CHF 150 for a non-Swiss matriculation certificate. 3-year (180 ECTS) bachelor's taught in German (C1 required); graduates continue to a 3-year Master of Medicine at a partner university (Zurich, Basel or USI Lugano), where the registrable federal diploma is taken. Only 100 places a year, awarded through the aptitude test (EMS); ETH states the programme is open only to holders of a Swiss passport or Swiss settlement permit, so Singaporeans without one cannot normally enrol. ETH is not itself on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications (Universität Zürich is).
